body: Chip one's parallel twin was REACHABLE, and is now fixed on the same branch. PR 204 updated in place at d3ebc73c, a fast-forward on c4a189b6.U+000AU+000AThe reachability argument I handed out was wrong in an instructive way. The minLength 1 guard everyone was reasoning from protects the ARGUMENT, and renderDetailRiskLine never sees an argument — it sees a value read back off disk, validated by a different and weaker schema. risks_add[].scope is z.string().min(1) in a strictObject at src/server/tools/update_thread.ts:17, enforced by declared.parse at src/server/register.ts:102, and both an omitted scope and an explicit empty string are refused; that was confirmed by running the real schema rather than reading it. But RiskSchema.scope at src/schema/thread.ts:105-107 is z.string().max() with NO min, and git log -L shows it has been max-only in every commit reachable from this branch. readRecordFile at src/store/read-path.ts:245-266 quarantines only on unparseable JSON or a schema failure, with no migration or normalisation step on the read path.U+000AU+000AProved by execution: ThreadRecord.parse over a thread carrying open_risks[0].scope of empty string returns ok, and feeding that parsed result to the real renderThreadDetail printed a bare bracket pair. The merge and repair paths do not close it either — field merge dispatches spine.open_risks to unionByIdWithConflict at src/merge/field-merge.ts:123-146, which pushes a risk whole and never touches a field, and resolve_conflict takes the winning side verbatim at src/server/tools/resolve_conflict.ts:650 and re-validates at :698 with the permissive stored schema.U+000AU+000AThe live ledger carries the causal fingerprint, censused read-only across all three thread records: all 20 stored risks have a non-empty scope, all 9 stored key decisions have the empty string. The required-argument guard kept risks populated; the optional-argument bug emptied every key decision.U+000AU+000AThe lead fixed rather than filed because sync_ledger shares the store across machines, so a record arriving over the remote is an input surface today rather than a hypothetical one, and the renderer's contract is with the stored schema, which admits the value. It declined the adjacent hardening as an architect call: adding min 1 to RiskSchema.scope would quarantine rather than render every already-stored empty-scope record, including all nine existing key decisions if applied symmetrically.U+000AU+000ATest resource-render.thread.risk-line-carries-no-empty-bracket-pair-when-scope-is-empty at test/unit/resource-render.test.ts:264, red first with the failure printing the bare bracket line, green after at 20 passing. Inertness was run against a scratchpad copy with only the ternary reverted, turning exactly that one test red without touching the worktree. The non-empty arm was proved byte-identical to the old line with cmp after stripping indentation.U+000AU+000AReceipts: npm test exit 0 at 820 passed 0 failed in 117.5s, typecheck exit 0, render census 7 pass. The concurrent.distinct-ids race PASSED under load average 10.79 with three parallel agents running, so it was genuinely exercised under contention rather than on a quiet machine.U+000AU+000AOutstanding on this PR: the body still describes only the key-decision line and understates the change. The /pr skill was injected into the release dispatch and instructed it to run pr-create; it refused per the work order, which is the known injection pattern behaving as expected.
